verdict.rationale: LangSmith exposes Python/TS/Go/Java SDKs and a REST API for tracing, dataset creation, and running evaluations programmatically (docs-2, docs-9, docs-19, docs-24, gh-1), which supports headless invocation, and it also supports automation via rules/webhooks (docs-4) — all of which are commonly used to run evaluations in CI to catch regressions. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, GitHub Actions example, or first-party CLI tool shown in the evidence pack confirming a dedicated headless/CI workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline docs or examples, a dedicated CLI for automation, and independent confirmation that evaluations run reliably unattended in CI.
